title: The lamp off
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies (the trilogy ran in print in three papers)
logline: Wednesday, between 'The Empty Chair' and 'The Box.' The daily version of the Sunday's last tier: the lamp, on. The lamp, off. The margin flat.

panels.composition: The low table at 4 AM. The lamp on. The bed beneath, empty. WOOD's hand at the lamp's switch.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a lowered drafting table at 4 AM with a green lamp lit and an empty dog bed beneath, a man's hand at the lamp's switch, no words

panels.composition: The lamp off. Black. The window's blue rain-light the only shape.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a nearly black panel with only a window's faint blue rain-light, no words

panels.composition: The lamp on again. The hand still at the switch. The bed.
